b1-masodikvh-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Kassa and the State of War
b1-masodikvh-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks what happened after the bombing of Kassa in June 1941.
b1-masodikvh-01.prompt: Tell the examiner who announced the state of war and what the army did as a consequence.
cues: Say who announced the state of war
Say what the army did as a consequence
b1-masodikvh-01.target: Bárdossy László bejelentette a hadiállapotot. A hadiállapot következtében a magyar hadsereg a keleti front felé indult.
b1-masodikvh-01.english: László Bárdossy announced the state of war. As a consequence of the state of war, the Hungarian army set off towards the Eastern Front.
b1-masodikvh-01.canDo: I can say how Hungary entered the war after the bombing of Kassa in 1941.

b1-masodikvh-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Don in January 1943
b1-masodikvh-02.scenario: A museum guide asks you about the Second Hungarian Army at the River Don.
b1-masodikvh-02.prompt: Tell the guide when the catastrophe happened and what the cold caused.
cues: Say when and where the catastrophe happened
Say what the extreme cold caused
b1-masodikvh-02.target: 1943 januárjában a Don mellett történt a katasztrófa. A rendkívüli hideg következtében sok katona megfagyott.
b1-masodikvh-02.english: The catastrophe happened by the Don in January 1943. As a consequence of the extreme cold, many soldiers froze to death.
b1-masodikvh-02.canDo: I can describe the Don catastrophe of January 1943 and the fate of the labour servicemen.

b1-masodikvh-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Remembering the Rescuers
b1-masodikvh-03.scenario: At a memorial in Budapest your teacher asks about 1944 and about the people who helped the persecuted.
b1-masodikvh-03.prompt: Tell your teacher when the Germans occupied Hungary and what Raoul Wallenberg did.
cues: Say the date of the German occupation
Say what Wallenberg did for the persecuted
b1-masodikvh-03.target: A németek 1944. március 19-én megszállták Magyarországot. Raoul Wallenberg kockáztatta az életét, és üldözötteket mentett meg.
b1-masodikvh-03.english: The Germans occupied Hungary on 19 March 1944. Raoul Wallenberg risked his life and saved persecuted people.
b1-masodikvh-03.canDo: I can describe the German occupation of 1944, the deportations and the rescuers.

b1-masodikvh-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Horthy's Armistice Attempt
b1-masodikvh-04.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks about October 1944.
b1-masodikvh-04.prompt: Tell the examiner how and when Horthy announced the armistice, and what happened to his attempt.
cues: Say when and where Horthy announced the armistice
Say what happened to the attempt
b1-masodikvh-04.target: Horthy 1944. október 15-én a rádióban jelentette be a fegyverszünetet. A kísérlet meghiúsult.
b1-masodikvh-04.english: Horthy announced the armistice on the radio on 15 October 1944. The attempt was thwarted.
b1-masodikvh-04.canDo: I can describe Horthy's failed armistice attempt and the Arrow Cross terror in 1944.

b1-masodikvh-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bridges of Budapest
b1-masodikvh-05.scenario: On a walk along the Danube your teacher asks what happened to Budapest at the end of the war.
b1-masodikvh-05.prompt: Tell your teacher what the retreating Germans did to the bridges and what the capital became.
cues: Say what the Germans did to the bridges
Say what the capital turned into
b1-masodikvh-05.target: A visszavonuló németek felrobbantották a hidakat. A főváros romhalmazzá vált.
b1-masodikvh-05.english: The retreating Germans blew up the bridges. The capital turned into a pile of rubble.
b1-masodikvh-05.canDo: I can describe the siege of Budapest and the end of the war in 1945.

b1-masodikvh-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: World War II in Review
b1-masodikvh-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks for a short summary of 1944-1945 for the citizenship interview.
b1-masodikvh-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher who led the Arrow Cross Party and when the siege of Budapest ended.
cues: Say who led the Arrow Cross Party
b1-masodikvh-consolidation.target: A nyilasokat Szálasi Ferenc vezette. Budapest ostroma 1945 februárjában ért véget.
b1-masodikvh-consolidation.english: The Arrow Cross was led by Ferenc Szálasi. The siege of Budapest ended in February 1945.
b1-masodikvh-consolidation.canDo: I can review the main events of Hungary in the Second World War.
